name: dumbbell high pull
description: An explosive pull that drives dumbbells up to chest height using the legs and hips. It builds the shoulders and traps and trains power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells hanging in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees and hips slightly, keeping your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and pull the weights up with elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height, elbows above your wrists.
Lower the dumbbells under control and reset.
